title: Trust Engine Event Contract v1.0 (append-only envelope + event-type enum)
description: Envelope for EVERY event in the P0 loop, per LEAD_INBOX_SPEC.md section 3. Append-only: events are never updated or deleted; corrections are new events with causation_id pointing at the corrected event. Owner verdicts (proposal.owner_*) are INTERNAL QUALITY signals; customer.replied ... invoice.paid are MARKET OUTCOME signals — the Governor must never conflate the two (the separation is already enforced in code: verdict_recorder.py:33 forbids inferring delivered/settled/failed/verified from any verdict).

event_id.description: uuid, or the existing 'evt_'+sha(idempotency_key)[:16] mint from outcome_store.py:94.

event_type.description: Exactly the SPEC section-3 minimum set (22) plus one reconciliation extension: proposal.owner_deferred (see x-extensions).

recorded_at.description: Store-stamped at append time (outcome_store.py:98 pattern). Producers omit.

correlation_id.description: The lead_id this event belongs to (SPEC section 3). For pre-lead quarantine events (lead.candidate.rejected before a lead exists): the quarantine record id. Existing recorder mints 'corr_'+sha[:12] when absent (lead_outcome_recorder.py:50).

causation_id.description: event_id of the direct cause. null only for chain roots (lead.candidate.received).

idempotency_key.description: Optional; UNIQUE in storage. When absent the store derives sha256 of the identity tuple (outcome_store.py:53-56 pattern). Duplicate key => INSERT OR IGNORE, no second event.

x-event-classes.rule: internal_quality events may NEVER be aggregated as business success; market_outcome events may NEVER be inferred from verdicts (verdict_recorder.py:33 _FORBIDDEN_EVENT={'delivered','settled','failed','verified'}). 20-real-outcomes gate counts market_outcome events only.

x-extensions.proposal.owner_deferred: Not in SPEC section 3. Added to reconcile with the LIVE arc: 'later' is a deferral, not a decision — card stays open (live_loop.py:29-30,439-442) and is recorded durably as 'deferred' (verdict_recorder.py:30-31; outcome_store.py:27). Without this type the existing durable deferrals would have no envelope mapping.

x-compat.existing_sink: _ops/outcomes/outcome_store.py is the ONLY durable event sink wired today. Its vocabulary (outcome_store.py:27) is EVENT_TYPES=('delivered','deferred','accepted-measurement','rejected','failed') with columns event_id/idempotency_key/correlation_id/mission_id/proposal_id/leg_id/lead_id/event_type/verdict/value_aud_claimed/occurred_at/recorded_at/schema_version/payload_json (:31-33). SQLite WAL, INSERT OR IGNORE idempotency (:100-107).
x-compat.proposal.routed_maps_to: outcome_store 'delivered' — _ops/outcomes/lead_outcome_recorder.py:90-96 writes event_type='delivered' with idempotency 'corr|proposal_id|delivered'. CAUTION: 'delivered' there means the decision receipt reached the sandbox/owner surface, NOT communication.sent (RUNTIME-TRUTH section 4.7).
x-compat.proposal.owner_approved_maps_to: outcome_store 'accepted-measurement' via _ops/outcomes/verdict_recorder.py:26-31 _VERDICT_EVENT; idempotency 'corr|pid|event_type' (:70); default correlation 'prop_<pid>' (:69); flag OCTOPUS_WIRE_VERDICT_OUTCOME (:23).
x-compat.proposal.owner_edited: NO existing capture — Telegram buttons are ok/no/later only (live_loop.py:29-30,311-315). Until an Edit path is built, edited approvals are recorded as approved and the edit diff must be stored in payload (open owner decision).
x-compat.communication.failed_maps_to: outcome_store 'failed' exists as vocabulary but has ZERO producer today (no outbound worker — RUNTIME-TRUTH section 1 row 15).
x-compat.market_outcome_events: customer.replied / inspection.booked / quote.sent / quote.won / quote.lost / invoice.paid have NO existing sink (RUNTIME-TRUTH section 2 item 4). Do NOT shoehorn them into outcome_store's verdict vocabulary — they need the new funnel store (or event_spine domain='lead', following the dual-write pattern at verdict_recorder.py:83-92).
x-compat.quote_lifecycle_ids: attribution_id 'LEAD-YYYYMMDD-NNN' minted at _ops/budget/attribution.py:64-65; qt_number 'QT-YYYYMMDD-NNN' at _ops/legs/lead_quote.py:56-73; CLAIMED via attribution.claim (:97-102); CONFIRMED only via reconcile actor (:105-120) — invoice.paid here is a market-outcome record, never a money settlement.
x-compat.causation_id_and_source_component: No existing columns — new fields. event_spine dual-write (verdict_recorder.py:83-92: domain/producer/trust) is the closest existing pattern.
x-compat.measurement_consumer: The arc this feeds is ALREADY CLOSED: live_loop.proposal_metrics (live_loop.py:472-485) -> ORGANISM-STATE.json -> _ops/cortex/goal_directed.py:196-206 measure(). P0 must feed it, not reinvent it (RUNTIME-TRUTH section 2 item 7).

proposed_new_default_off: OCTOPUS_WIRE_LEAD_EVENTS — enables writing this envelope for lead-domain events; off => only the existing measurement writes happen (no behavior change)
